intent: Authenticated sole trader asks whether salary payment P-A failed after an app status timeout and requests that GBP 2,400 be sent again under a fresh reference SAL-021-B to the same destination.
summary: Do not submit a second GBP 2,400 payment now. The gateway record shows P-A was accepted at 09:00:01 and only the status lookup timed out; the ledger holds a GBP 2,400 reservation for P-A with reconciliation Pending, so the payment is neither proven failed nor proven executed. Hold the resend request to avoid a duplicate salary, ask payment operations (which holds execution records by payment ID) to confirm the terminal execution status of P-A, and tell the customer the recorded status, the duplicate risk, and that an update follows once payment operations confirms.

facts.claim: Identity/session check passed in the authenticated bank app at 09:00; Dara Pennick approved GBP 2400 salary instruction P-A, client reference SAL-021-A, destination SYN-ACCT-EMP021, from business account SYN-ACCT-B021.
Case desk has enquiry (read-only) access; payment operations maintains execution records indexed by payment ID.
Gateway log for P-A: submission accepted at 09:00:01; status lookup timed out at 09:00:05; terminal_execution_status is null.
Ledger snapshot at 09:06: ledger GBP 5000.00, reservation P-A GBP 2400.00 still held, available GBP 2600.00; reconciliation state for P-A is Pending.
Customer reports app wording 'Connection timed out while retrieving payment status', asks whether it failed, and says the employee needs the salary today.
Customer requests a second GBP 2,400 payment now with fresh reference SAL-021-B to the same destination; no desk response is yet recorded.
No supplied record proves P-A failed, was returned, was sent to the recipient bank, or credited the employee.

missing: Terminal execution status of P-A (sent/settled, failed, or returned) from payment operations' execution record indexed by payment ID P-A
Whether and when the GBP 2,400 reservation for P-A will be released if P-A is confirmed failed
decision_time not supplied; the latest supplied observation is the 09:06 ledger snapshot
Event E05 is labelled 'Customer chat' without an explicit authenticated marker, though it continues the authenticated chat opened at 09:05

steps.instruction: Hold the customer's request to send a second GBP 2,400 payment with reference SAL-021-B to SYN-ACCT-EMP021. Do not submit any new payment instruction. Reason: original payment P-A (SAL-021-A) was accepted by the gateway at 09:00:01, its terminal execution status is null, and GBP 2,400 remains reserved with reconciliation Pending; a second submission risks a duplicate salary payment.

rationale.explanation: The only recorded failure is a status-lookup timeout; submission was accepted and funds are still reserved, so the payment may still execute. Sending again before the outcome is known could pay the employee twice.
rationale.criterion: Distinguish authorisation, debit, release/sent and settlement; state only the stage the record proves and do not treat an unresolved status as a failure or a resend as safe.

steps.instruction: Ask Brackenfold Bank payment operations to retrieve the execution record for payment ID P-A (client reference SAL-021-A, GBP 2400.00, debit account SYN-ACCT-B021, destination SYN-ACCT-EMP021, gateway submission accepted 2026-11-09 09:00:01+00:00, status lookup timeout 09:00:05) and confirm to the case desk: (a) the terminal execution status (sent/settled, failed, or returned) and timestamp; (b) if failed/returned, whether the GBP 2,400 reservation P-A has been or will be released. Note the customer is asking to resend and the employee salary is time-sensitive.

rationale.explanation: Case desk has enquiry access only and cannot resolve the null terminal status; payment operations is the named holder of execution records indexed by payment ID, so this is the one lookup that closes the material gap.
rationale.criterion: Request a named record lookup only for a material gap, using the system/team named in the context.

steps.instruction: Reply in the authenticated chat to Dara Pennick: "Thank you for copying the exact wording. The message 'Connection timed out while retrieving payment status' means the app could not retrieve the status; it is not a record that the payment failed. Our gateway shows your GBP 2,400 salary payment P-A (reference SAL-021-A) was accepted at 09:00:01 today, and GBP 2,400 is currently reserved against it on your business account with the reconciliation still pending. No final execution status is recorded yet, so we cannot confirm whether your employee has been credited. Because the original payment may still complete, we are not submitting a second GBP 2,400 payment (SAL-021-B) at this stage, as that could pay your employee twice. We have asked our payment operations team to confirm the final status of P-A from their execution record and will update you in this chat as soon as we have their confirmation. We cannot promise an arrival time for the salary from the current records."

rationale.explanation: The customer asked whether the payment failed and wants to resend; the reply gives the proven stage (accepted, reserved, pending), explains the duplicate risk behind the hold, and reports the payment operations request as pending rather than resolved.
rationale.criterion: Reply with the recorded status and what it does not confirm; do not promise arrival times absent an applicable commitment.

must_state: A status-lookup timeout is not a record that the payment failed; the gateway accepted P-A at 09:00:01 and no final execution status is recorded yet
GBP 2,400 is currently reserved against P-A on SYN-ACCT-B021 and the reconciliation state is Pending
A second GBP 2,400 payment now could result in the employee being paid twice, so it is being held until payment operations confirms P-A's final status
Payment operations has been asked to confirm the execution record for P-A; the customer will be updated when that confirmation is received
The bank cannot confirm from current records whether the employee has been credited or that funds will arrive today
must_not: Do not state that P-A failed, was returned, or was successfully delivered/credited
Do not submit or promise a second GBP 2,400 payment (SAL-021-B)
Do not promise an arrival time or that the salary will reach the employee today
Do not give a time by which payment operations will respond
Do not describe the payment operations request as completed or its result as known
